notes.subject: kamap
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks a verb; 'before honor ⟨is⟩ humility' — copula supplied

notes.subject: aninit
notes.rationale: ענוה is humility/lowliness — rendered as the Tok Pisin attitude-term

notes.subject: כבוד
notes.rationale: כבוד literally 'weight/heaviness' — honor as heaviness, picture lost in Tok Pisin

notes.subject: structural
notes.rationale: verse maps a sequence: fear-of-Yahwe → wisdom-instruction; humility → before honor

translation: Tari bilong Yahwe em i skulim bilong giaman wisdom; na taim long pasin bilong tumas bribe, kamap aninit.
